scope: One bounded fresh primary-literature and public-source pass across organoid/tumoroid, explant/ex-vivo, patient-derived xenograft and functional-precision sarcoma studies. stop: No target fishing or paper from an inventory. If no new suitable measured input or scientifically useful inference is found, report that bounded result and finish. Do not assert that unsearched sources or all possible analyses are exhausted.
